app_metadata.core_purpose: Industry-level mobile authentication, registration, OTP verification, and onboarding flow for AzoApp partners & merchants.

emotional_archetype.name: TACTICAL PERFORMANCE & EARNING TRUST
emotional_archetype.vibe: High-confidence, professional, crisp, tactical yet approachable. Delivers immediate clarity whether the user is logging in or registering, and distinct visual identity between Partner (Technician) and Merchant (Shopkeeper) roles.

register_state.label: REGISTER MODE
register_state.sublabel: Create new partner or merchant account

hero_area.description: Top hero banner featuring transparent PNG uniformed professional, with subtle circular radial glowing backdrop and brand title chip.

role_action_stack.description: Full-width actions stacked vertically (one per line). Distinct green theme for Partner and purple theme for Merchant.

hero_png_treatment.rule: MUST use background-removed transparent PNG image of uniformed pro. Render with expo-image component (contentFit='contain'). Anchored cleanly toward bottom of hero area.
hero_png_treatment.background_glow: Radial circular linear-gradient behind transparent PNG (from #DBEAFE to transparent) so PNG pops cleanly without dark background box.

micro_interactions.button_press: Scale down to 0.97 on press, spring back with tension 300.
micro_interactions.mode_switch: Smooth layout animation (FadeIn / FadeOut / SlideInRight) when toggling LOGIN vs REGISTER mode.
micro_interactions.otp_shake: Horizontal 6px shake animation (200ms) on invalid OTP attempt.
micro_interactions.empty_state_fade: FadeInUp with 10px translate on empty state appearance.

accessibility.min_touch_target: 48dp x 48dp for all buttons, inputs, and toggles.
accessibility.color_contrast: Text #0F172A on #FFFFFF (15:1 contrast ratio). Subtext #475569 on #FFFFFF (7:1 ratio). Meets WCAG AAA.
accessibility.screen_reader: All interactive buttons have accessibilityLabel and testID props set.
accessibility.keyboard_handling: KeyboardAvoidingView with behavior='padding' on iOS and scrollable container.

3d_libraries.status: Not required for native mobile auth screen
3d_libraries.recommendation: Use 2D vector gradients (expo-linear-gradient) and crisp expo-image transparent assets for maximum performance and instant load times on low-end mobile devices.

image_urls.description: Friendly uniformed service pro with tools, high resolution transparent background PNG hero image

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace flat dark box background behind hero image with a soft gradient radial blur glow, rendering hero image as a clean transparent PNG.
2. Add explicit Mode Indicator / Segmented Toggle at the top of the auth card so user instantly sees if they are in 'LOGIN' or 'REGISTER' mode.
3. Use distinct theme colors for role registrations: Partner buttons and badges use Green (#10B981 / #047857), Merchant buttons and badges use Purple (#9333EA / #6B21A8).
4. Maintain full support for 10-digit Indian (+91) mobile OTP verification flow with 6 individual OTP input boxes.
5. Stack 'Register as Partner' and 'Register as Merchant' as two full-width separate action buttons (one per line).
6. Include empty state ('No Partner or Merchant account found') when an unregistered number completes verification, with instant registration pathways.
7. Include optional demo one-click login buttons for Partner and Merchant when demo mode is active.
8. Ensure every button and input element has a data-testid or testID prop for automated test stability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI template looks by giving depth, clear mode contrast, and refined micro-interactions.
Never use dark background gradients on text containers.
Ensure touch targets are at least 48dp.
All interactive elements must include testID or data-testid attributes.
